> Former gist: <https://chk.me/4KijErW>
>
> Most of the commands below can be run from the “Run Box” with the shortcuts
> `WIN+R` or `WIN+E CTRL+L`.
>
> To run the commands with admin privileges, hit `Ctrl+Shift+Enter` after typing them.
>
> See also the keyboard shortcuts:
> https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/accessibility/windows/keyboard-shortcuts-in-windows
> https://support.microsoft.com/fr-fr/accessibility/windows/keyboard-shortcuts-in-windows

```shell
## GET WINDOWS VERSION

winver

## GET SYSTEM INFORMATION

msinfo32

## SHUTDOWN / RESTART COMPUTER

# https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-server/administration/windows-commands/shutdown

shutdown /p

shutdown /r

## OPEN DEVICE MANAGER

devmgmt.msc

## OPEN TASK MANAGER (CTRL+SHIFT+ESC)

taskmgr

## TERMINALS

# ⚠️ Use ✅ PowerShell (v7) not 🚫 Windows PowerShell (v5). They are different applications.
# https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/scripting/whats-new/differences-from-windows-powershell

```

| Command          | Name                                                                                     |
| ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pwsh`           | ✅ PowerShell (7.6.5)                                                                    |
| `wt`             | 🚫 Windows PowerShell (5.1.26100.8457)                                                   |
| `powershell`     | 🚫 Windows PowerShell (5.1.26100.8457)                                                   |
| `powershell_ise` | 🚫 Windows PowerShell (5.1.26100.8457)                                                   |
| `cmd`            | COMMAND.COM, cmd.exe, Command Prompt, Windows Command Processor, Command Processor Shell |

```shell
## GET TERMINAL VERSION

Get-Process -Id $PID | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Path; $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString()

## SET “WINDOWS TERMINAL” AS DEFAULT
## IN SYSTEM/ADVANCED
## (OLD DEFAULT WAS “WINDOWS CONSOLE HOST”)

WIN+R
ms-settings:developers
# search for terminal

## KILL A TASK

taskkill /im filename.exe /t /f

## OPEN FONT DIRECTORY

%WINDIR%/Fonts
shell:fonts
%CSIDL_FONTS%

## OPEN USER DIRECTORY

%HOMEPATH%
%USERPROFILE%

## OPEN 64 BIT PROGRAM FILES DIRECTORY (x64)

%PROGRAMFILES%

## OPEN 32 BIT PROGRAM FILES DIRECTORY (x86)

%PROGRAMFILES(X86)%

## OPEN “OPTIONAL FEATURES” WINDOW

OptionalFeatures.exe

## OPEN WINDOWS EXPLORER

WIN+E

## SHOW DESKTOP

WIN+D

## SHOW SETTINGS

WIN+I

## LOCK SCREEN

WIN+L

## CHECK FOR UPDATES

ms-settings:windowsupdate

## DISABLE ANNOYING SOUNDS

mmsys.cpl
# click on 3rd tab “Sounds”
# choose “No Sounds” in dropdown “Sound Schemes”

## INSTALL

### NOTE: --scope machine => MSI, machine-wide scope (!= MSIX, current user scope only). Requires admin (elevated terminal).
### À vérifier : --scope machine => changer pour : --installer-type wix

winget install -e --id Git.Git                          --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
winget install -e --id GitHub.cli                       --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
winget install -e --id Microsoft.VisualStudioCode       --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
winget install -e --id Hugo.Hugo.Extended               --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
winget install -e --id PedroAlbanese.QREncode           --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
# winget install -e --id Sass.DartSass                    --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
# winget install -e --id Sass.DartSass.Embedded           --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;

git config --global user.name "NicHub on Windows";
git config --global user.email "nicolas.jeanmonod@gmail.com";
git clone https://github.com/ouilogique/enfants-kara.ch.git

# set pwsh as default
# Win+R pwsh
# Ctrl+,
# Default profile: PowerShell (And not Windows PowerShell)

winget search Python # liste des versions Python disponibles
winget install -e --id Microsoft.WindowsTerminal              --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
winget install -e --id Microsoft.PowerShell                   --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
winget install -e --id Python.Python.3.14                     --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
winget install -e --id OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS                      --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
winget install -e --id Brave.Brave                            --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
winget install -e --id Mozilla.Firefox.DeveloperEdition       --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
winget install -e --id BurntSushi.ripgrep.MSVC                --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
winget install -e --id sharkdp.fd                             --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
winget install -e --id Neovim.Neovim                          --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
winget install -e --id PuTTY.PuTTY                            --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
winget install -e --id WiresharkFoundation.Wireshark          --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
winget install -e --id EclipseFoundation.Mosquitto            --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
winget install -e --id Rclone.Rclone                          --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
winget install -e --id WinSCP.WinSCP                          --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
winget install -e --id TimKosse.FileZilla.Client              --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
winget install -e --id Microsoft.VisualStudio.2022.BuildTools --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
& "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\setup.exe" modify `
    --installPath "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\BuildTools" `
    --add Microsoft.VisualStudio.Workload.VCTools `
    --add Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Tools.ARM64 `
    --includeRecommended `
    --quiet `
    --wait `
    --norestart
npm install -g @openai/codex

### Upgrade all
winget upgrade --all

### Upgrade single
winget upgrade --id Microsoft.VisualStudioCode --installer-type wix --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements
winget upgrade --id Microsoft.PowerShell --installer-type wix --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements

## OpenCode sans WSL (déconseillé)

npm config set allow-scripts=opencode-ai --location=user
npm install -g opencode-ai

```

```shell
## WSL — Windows Subsystem for Linux

### Requirements

# Vérifier que la virtualisation est activée dans le BIOS.
# Dans le BIOS, l’option s’appelle par ex. sur HP : `System Configuration/Virtualization Technology`.
# Vérifier dans PowerShell :
systeminfo | findstr /i "Virtualization"

### Install WSL

wsl --install
shutdown /r
wsl -l -v
wsl --install Ubuntu-26.04

### Usefull WSL commands

wsl                # démarre dans la distro par défaut (Ubuntu)
wsl -d Ubuntu      # démarre une distro précise
wsl -l -v          # liste les distros installées + leur version
wsl --update       # met à jour WSL

## Change default browser
ms-settings:defaultapps

## Change color theme
ms-settings:colors

## Coreutils: 78 Linux commands for powershell
## https://github.com/microsoft/coreutils
## ls "C:\Program Files\coreutils\bin\"
## https://youtu.be/Bg8FjRGuW_w?t=356
winget install Microsoft.Coreutils

## Install WSL1
dism.exe /online /enable-feature /featurename:Microsoft-Windows-Subsystem-Linux /all /norestart
## Optional
dism.exe /online /enable-feature /featurename:VirtualMachinePlatform /all /norestart
## Reboot
# Télécharger le MSI officiel Microsoft (WSL redistribuable)
curl.exe -L -o "$env:TEMP\wsl_update.msi" "https://aka.ms/wslupdate"
Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$env:TEMP\wsl_update.msi","/qn" -Wait
wsl --set-default-version 1
wsl --install -d Ubuntu
```
